notes.subject: שחרה
notes.rationale: 'moning bilong en' (dawn — samting nogut i kamap bipo klok) o JPS 'yu no save long pasin bilong kapsait en ausait' — root שחר i 'dawn'.

notes.subject: כפרה
notes.rationale: Root כפר 'karim/skruelim' — 'yu no inap skruelim en' o 'yu no inap rausim en'; Tok Pisin 'skruel' i holim pasin bilong baim bek.

notes.subject: הוה / שואה
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i klin long saund (–הָה) na ol i repim — trabel na bagarap i kamap wan wan taim; Tok Pisin i no save holim dispela lain.

notes.subject: yu no save
notes.rationale: Tripela taim 'yu no save' — samting i kamap i stap hait long Babel, em i no inap lukim bipo.

translation: Na samting nogut i kamap antap long yu — yu no save long moning bilong en; na trabel i pundaun antap long yu — yu no inap skruelim en; na bagarap i kamap antap long yu sut naraspela, yu no save long en.
